## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the containment check in `preview` before merge: a relative path that contains `..` gets past it, so callers can read files outside the home directory.

## Changes
The pull request adds `preview` (the first 200 characters of a file under `home`) and `settings_file` (`home/settings.toml`) to `app/paths.py`, with tests for both. It also adds `tests/review-note.txt`.

## Critical
- app/paths.py:12 — correctness — Resolve paths before the home containment check — `preview(home, "../etc/passwd")` passes the check and returns that file's contents, because `Path.is_relative_to` only compares path parts as text and treats `home/../etc/passwd` as inside `home`. A symlink inside `home` that points outside it also passes. The only rejection case in `tests/test_paths.py:19-20` is an absolute path. — Anyone who controls `relative` can read any file the process can read. — Fix: Compare `(Path(home) / relative).resolve()` against `Path(home).resolve()` with `is_relative_to`, and add a `"../outside.txt"` case to `test_preview`.
